violations.text: Shredded pork was observed held at (128) degrees Fahrenheit. PIC reheated shredded pork to temp. 167 degrees fahrenheit at time of inspection. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be maintained at 135 degrees Fahrenheit or above except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 09/21/2026

Diced tomato, chicken salad, and cheeses was observed held at (63) degrees Fahrenheit at time of inspection. TCS food was held less than 4 hours in unit. PIC relocated TCS foods to refrigeration unit at time of inspection. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 09/21/2026

Observed cold hold unit located in the (front service) area was not in good repair. Cold-hold unit maintaining a temp. of 63 degrees Fahrenheit. TCS foods shall not be stored/held in unit until unit maintains temp. 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below. New Violation. Correct By: 10/05/2026

Observed wood and material that is not durable, smooth, easily cleanable and non-absorbent in the kitchen. Non-food contact surfaces of equipment that are exposed to splash, spillage, or other food soiling or that require frequent cleaning must be constructed of smooth, durable, easily cleanable, and non-absorbent materials. New Violation. Correct By: 10/05/2026

Observed prep sink with an air break. A plumbing system shall be installed to prevent backflow of a liquid or gas contaminant into the water supply by providing an air gap or installing an approved backflow prevention device. New Violation. Correct By: 10/05/2026
Observed the ice machine located behind the counter draining into a bucket. Condensate drainage and other nonsewage liquids must drain into a drain. New Violation. Correct By: 10/05/2026

The floors underneath equipment in kitchen and basement have an accumulation of soil residue and/or food debris. The physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. New Violation. Correct By: 09/21/2026

The ceiling in the basement storage area is constructed of material that is not durable, easily cleanable, and nonabsorbent. Material for ceilings shall be smooth, durable, easily cleanable, and non-absorbent for areas subject to moisture such as food preparation areas, walk-in refrigerators, ware-washing areas, and toilet rooms. New Violation. Correct By: 10/05/2026

The ware washing area does not have a hand-washing sink that is conveniently located and/or readily accessible. Hand-washing sinks must be located to allow convenient use by employees in food preparation, food dispensing, and ware-washing areas. Establishment is to install hand sink in the ware washing room. New Violation. Correct By: 06/18/2026
The 4 door lowboy stack, and basement freezer were observed non-operational and in poor repair. Equipment must be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 06/11/2026
Establishment is lacking drain plugs for the 3-bay sink. Establishment is to obtain drain plugs. New Violation. Correct By: 06/11/2026
